title: Q-CIFAIL-mergeaudit-1759: PR #1759 merged without a green checks run
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation mergeaudit --probe 1759
**Status:** closed

MERGE-AUDIT-1: PR #1759 (STATEFUL-MIGRATE-1: test D1 migrations against a populated database) merged at 2026-11-21T16:21:05Z with its `checks` run at `failure` on head d5aa8bb. Some merge path skipped the green gate.

Fix what that run caught on main (run the failed step from .github/workflows/checks.yml locally), then confirm a later merged PR passed `checks`. Do not weaken a check.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T16:51:20Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-21T17:52:49Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 2 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: ValueError: need 1..8 files, got 11. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T03:31:23Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: green since
